discrepancies.text: RESULTS.md says "P8 holds at J1: 1.002 [0.934, 1.074]". PROTOCOL.md section 7 P8 requires an interval containing 1 and inside [0.93, 1.07]; the upper end 1.0743 exceeds 1.07, so P8 fails at J1 as written. The numbers are right; the classification is not.

P4 does not say whether its interval is per job or pooled. The per-job reading (section 6.1 compares) fails in every job under both the linearised and the bootstrap interval. A pooled reading, not preregistered and computed here only as a sensitivity, gives 1.3109 [1.2239, 1.4041] over 80 workloads, which would clear 1.2. Section 10 forbids choosing it after the data, so the verdict stays inconclusive. Derived, not measured: sqrt(2) x 1.0135 / 1.0934 = 1.311, so the 1.41 prediction assumed rho.negation at its floor.

The sessions git_commit e374755bd7 is not the build source. e374755 and dbd587a01a are siblings (merge-base 8bb2629dd3) and differ in five src files, including src/cryptanalysis/ic_boundary.rs and src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/methods.rs. A rebuild from the session git_commit would not reproduce a18af09f; the binding is through the binary sha256 and build-info.json. RESULTS.md explains this correctly, but the e374755 link rests on the GitHub API, not on receipts/image-publication.json.

protocol.json arms[].instrument.build is `cargo build --release --bin ecbench`. The pinned binary was built by taskq/deploy/eks-karpenter/build-bundle with `cargo +1.99.1 build --locked --release --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --bin ecbench` and RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=x86-64. The protocol build line would not give the pinned hash. Sessions record git_dirty null; a clean tree is asserted only inside build-bundle.

PROTOCOL.md section 5 says the cluster bootstrap runs "over the sizes' workloads". The harness resamples sizes, then runs, and has no workload stage. Sensitivity with a sizes, workloads, runs bootstrap: [1.0215, 1.1629]. The M line is unchanged.

RESULTS.md does not state P1, P5, P9 or the Holm family of the secondary methods. Recomputed: P1 holds on its point (1.093 inside [1.00, 1.10]). P5: beta 0.578 is outside 0.8-1 on its point, its interval [0.21, 1.89] contains that range, and model A is not rejected (p 0.51). P9: no curve effect after Holm (smallest p 0.088 with run-level SE, 0.141 with the sealed size intervals).
build-info.json source_repository is https://github.com/aburan28/crypto (hard-coded in build-bundle), but the workflow ran in isogeny-labs/crypto.

The twelve sealed medium bounds are already in docs/bounds/frontier.json and FRONTIER.md. That is outside the validation gate, which covers the IC leaderboard and benchmarks/README.md. No IC leaderboard or benchmarks row cites this study, and no pcc claim exists.

limitations: No independent rebuild of ecbench: my first source export (a full-repository git archive) filled the shared disk, and the coordinator told me to use the frozen binary. Every replay, the producer's included, therefore ran the same a18af09f binary. The replay checks cross-host determinism, not compiler or source independence.

The validator code is stdlib Python, as the dispatch asked. AGENTS.md "Implementation language: no Python" excludes Python certificate verifiers, replay tools and result generators from the repository, so the scripts are not committed (hashes above). Gate use may need a native re-implementation.
The curve generator generate_instance(generic, bits, seed) was not re-run. The curves were checked arithmetically and the seed rule was recomputed.

The uniform_scalar_sha256_v1 target derivation was not re-implemented. target = [planted]G and recovered == planted were checked for all 2800 records, and the 90 sampled child inputs match their records.
The R(N) parametric-bootstrap intervals were not recomputed; only the point fits and weighted means were.
The wall-time figures, the experiment.export gap and the benchmark-record launch-entry gap were not assessed (no wall time is admitted under section 10).
research-kb and Conductor are not installed here, so neither was consulted.
No pcc claim or keyring signature exists; every number here is [pcc:unverified].
errors: git archive of the whole dbd587a01a tree into the scratchpad filled the shared disk to 0 bytes free (about 4.1 GB). The extraction was stopped and the tree deleted, and the disk is back to 7.4 GB free. No from-source build was attempted after that.
My first phase-accounting check (gae = adds + doubles) was wrong for counter-priced phases. I replaced it with the rho counter identity, which holds on every record.
My first harness-resampler replica used the unsalted seed. The harness uses seed ^ 0xF for ratio_to_floor and seed ^ 0x5 for S; with the salts, the sealed intervals reproduce to 2e-15.
